title: Implement idempotent caravan sync and rolling head advancement
description: Fourth wave under bd-caab31. Implement the deterministic sync state machine from SPEC.md over validated graphs and mutation primitives: acquire operation lock, rediscover, recognize merged labelled predecessors, retarget only the child to default, advance rolling caravan ID, walk head-to-tail, enforce adjacent/head/fleet compatibility, disable auto-merge on non-heads, enable squash auto-merge on a consistent head, and return the first structured decision point with completed steps/suggested actions. Support current caravan and `--all`; reruns must resume solely from GitHub state. Defer detailed CI failure/force-squash policy to its successor bead. Add interrupted-step and repeated-no-op tests.
creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0

title: Define Caravan domain model and strict repository config
description: First parallel lane under bd-caab31. Implement the stable core types from SPEC.md (PR snapshot, checks/automerge state, caravan chain/fleet, graph/decision kinds, optimistic preconditions, operation/event IDs) plus strict `.caravan/config.yaml` loading/validation with version, force_merge, loop, and hook policy. Keep this lane pure and GitHub-I/O-free in new focused modules (primarily src/model.rs and src/config.rs); update AppContext to carry resolved config. Replace no command stubs except config-related plumbing. Add serde/schema/unit tests and preserve CLI/MCP DTO stability for the other lanes.
creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0

title: Implement non-mutating Git compatibility checks and local operation lock
description: First parallel lane under bd-caab31. Implement the mechanical compatibility primitive from SPEC.md without rewriting history or touching the worktree: fetch/resolve exact refs safely, use `git merge-tree` (or an equivalent isolated temporary index/worktree-free operation), return structured clean/conflict evidence, and cover adjacent, head-to-main, and ordered cross-caravan head-to-tail calls. Also implement a repository-scoped exclusive operation lock under Git metadata with clear contention/staleness errors; read-only callers remain unlocked. Keep the API independent of GitHub discovery so this lane can land in parallel. Add temp-repository tests for clean/conflicting merges and lock contention.
creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0

title: Implement safe eviction and caravan splitting
description: Fourth wave under bd-caab31. Replace `evict` and `split` stubs using optimistic mutation receipts. Eviction must preflight the child-to-predecessor/default replacement edge and whole-fleet compatibility before mutation, then disable auto-merge, remove active/force labels, add `caravan-evicted`, retarget any child, and emit the supplied reason. Splitting retargets a non-head to default and validates both resulting caravans plus cross-fleet invariants. Never leave an invalid graph silently; partial remote steps return resumable evidence. Add head/middle/tail, incompatible gap, stale race, and split compatibility tests.
creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0

title: Specify and scaffold the Caravan Rust CLI
description: Encode the operator's agent-in-the-loop merge-queue design in SPEC.md, critically resolve or explicitly record key semantic gaps, then scaffold a Rust `cara` CLI using the established mcp-cli, updatable-cli, and feedback-cli ecosystem patterns plus a Nix flake and baseline CI/docs. The initial executable should expose agent-friendly help and structurally register the planned command surface without pretending unimplemented queue operations work. After landing the foundation, decompose the implementation into parallel, dependency-aware beads for crvn-dev-msm-0/1/2.
creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0

title: Add CI decisions, reruns, caravan-force, and autonomous squash merge
description: Fifth wave under bd-caab31. Extend sync with normalized GitHub check state: pending is a no-op/wait, failed unforced checks yield a `ci_failure` decision, agents can rerun exact failed checks, and `caravan-force` allows the PR to remain in-chain. When a forced PR reaches head, autonomously admin-squash only if config force_merge=true, label present, current head is conflict-free with default, and actor permission succeeds; no approval hook. Emit auditable attempt/result events and never bypass textual conflicts. Test green/pending/spurious/real failures, forced downstream behavior, denied permissions, stale head, and one-shot force merge.
creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0

title: Implement gh-backed repository and pull-request discovery
description: First parallel lane under bd-caab31. Build a narrow command-runner seam around `git` and authenticated `gh`, then discover repository/default branch/current branch/current PR plus open and recently merged labelled PR snapshots needed to derive caravans and advance merged heads. Use typed JSON queries, preserve exact head/base SHAs and auto-merge/check metadata, reject fork-only predecessor branches, and make subprocess behavior hermetic-testable with a fake runner. Work in focused adapter/discovery modules; do not implement graph policy or mutations. Rebase onto the core model bead when it lands and map adapter DTOs into its canonical types.
creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0

title: Implement versioned hooks and lightweight cara loop
description: Fifth wave under bd-caab31. Implement SPEC hook events and foreground `cara loop`: run configured shell commands with one versioned JSON object on stdin, secret-free CARA_* context, stable operation/event IDs, timeout, and per-hook blocking policy. Decision-point sync always stops after firing; repeated ticks may fire again, so document/test external dedup/lock responsibility rather than persisting internal authority. Best-effort failures report without rollback; blocking failures become typed hook_failure. Loop repeatedly invokes sync --all, supports interval override and --once, handles signals cleanly, and keeps no queue database. Expose bounded hook status through outputs but not unbounded loop over MCP.
creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0

title: Build end-to-end fake-GitHub acceptance suite and finish v1 parity
description: Final v1 gate under bd-caab31. Compose all landed lanes into hermetic acceptance scenarios over temporary Git repos plus a stateful fake `gh`: create multiple caravans, join by tail/head, navigate, advance a squash-merged head, tolerate external main movement, stop/repair/resume link conflicts, evict/rejoin/split, handle CI rerun/force, exercise hooks/loop dedup metadata, and prove stale distributed preconditions fail closed. Assert human CLI, --json mcp-cli envelopes, and MCP tools share results/errors and that no remaining domain command returns skeleton not_implemented. Add release-asset/self-update smoke or file a narrowly scoped successor if cross-platform release infrastructure is not present. Update README examples from planned to working and close only with the full SPEC command matrix covered.
creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0

title: Derive and validate caravan graphs; implement read-only commands
description: Second wave under bd-caab31. After bd-304e50, bd-6f84d1, and bd-463847 land, derive open labelled PRs into acyclic linear chains with rolling head IDs; reconcile/diagnose dangling merged-head bases; enforce all SPEC graph, head-to-main, adjacent, and ordered cross-caravan head-to-tail compatibility invariants; and return structured invalid_graph/decision evidence. Replace `status`, `show`, and read-only `check` stubs in shared CLI/MCP handlers with human and JSON outputs. Do not mutate GitHub or check out branches. Add fixture-heavy tests for valid multiple caravans, cycles, branching, orphan bases, evicted-label conflicts, and current-PR position.
creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0

title: Implement Caravan v1 agent-in-the-loop merge queue
description: Parent delivery epic for the SPEC.md v1 contract: GitHub discovery, graph validation, mechanical compatibility, membership mutations, navigation, sync/head advancement, CI and force-squash decisions, hooks/loop, MCP parity, and end-to-end verification. Work is intentionally split into dependency-aware lanes for crvn-dev-msm-0/1/2; this epic is coordination-only and must not be auto-claimed as an implementation bead.
creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0

title: Implement safe PR and caravan-fleet navigation
description: Third wave under bd-caab31. Replace `next`, `prev`, `van list`, `van next`, and `van prev` stubs using the validated graph. Refuse dirty worktrees, in-progress Git operations, ambiguous branch/PR mappings, unsafe local branch replacement, head/tail boundaries, and fork-only heads; use an injectable checkout runner with exact PR/head evidence. Fleet browsing order is head PR number ascending and is explicitly not queue priority. Add temp-repo/fake-gh tests and preserve the caller's worktree on every refusal.
creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0

title: Implement optimistic PR mutation engine and new/join flows
description: Third wave under bd-caab31. Build GitHub mutation primitives with exact head/base/label/state/automerge optimistic preconditions and step receipts, then replace `new`, `renew`, `join`, and `rejoin` stubs. Support `--create-pr` via noninteractive `gh pr create --fill`, exact `--tail-pr`, dynamic `--head-pr`, and unique-tail inference; apply/clear caravan labels in safe order; target default or tail branch; enforce fleet compatibility before mutation; and enable auto-merge only for a newly consistent head. Multi-step failures must report completed steps and be rerun-safe. Add fake-GitHub tests for success, ambiguity, stale races, partial progress, active/evicted rejection, and rollback-impossible receipts.
creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0
